nl.text: For natural numbers n and r, if `2 + 2*r ≤ n`, then there exists `PerturbedStarBlocks n r`.  The asserted data may be chosen by reserving two distinguished points of `Fin n` and embedding two consecutive, shifted ranges of length `r`; consequently its two blocks have cardinality `r`, are disjoint, avoid both distinguished points, and the distinguished points are distinct.
